event_description: A user successfully signed in with email and password.
A user explicitly signed out of their session.
A new team member accepted their invitation and completed account setup.
A new customer quote was created with line items.
A quote was accepted and converted into a production job.
A new job was created directly from a customer purchase order.
One or more production jobs were bulk cancelled.
An operator recorded completion of a manufacturing operation step.
A shipment was created to fulfill part of a job.
A new part was added to the company's parts catalog.
Stock level at a location was added, depleted, adjusted, or moved by an owner-side user.
Stock level at a location was added, depleted, adjusted, or moved by a shop-floor operator.
